docs.title: Release Blog
docs.text:
Latest cuPQC SDK release blog posts with version highlights, changelogs, and download links.

cuPQC v0.4 August 21, 2025 Improve Data Integrity and Security with Accelerated Hash Functions and Merkle Trees

Expanded hash function support (SHA-2, SHA-3, SHAKE, Poseidon 2) and comprehensive Merkle tree calculations. Enables efficient data integrity verification, membership proofs, zero-knowledge proofs, and hash-based signatures with GPU acceleration.

Read Blog Post → Download cuPQC v0.2 December 3, 2024 Introducing cuPQC SDK for GPU-Accelerated Post-Quantum Cryptography

Initial release introducing GPU-accelerated NIST-approved PQC operations including ML-KEM and ML-DSA. Achieves breakthrough performance with 13.3 million key generations per second for ML-KEM-768 on H100 GPU. Comprehensive side-channel security reviews ensure robust protection.
